limitations: No human approval; this is an independent bounded no-password-change control, not an extension of the approved mutation experiment.
Original source snapshots are reused without changing their acquisition hashes or dates.
Reference exchange uses A's original refresh token and may return the same refresh bytes; no independent third session or lineage is claimed.
All scheduled primary/derived operations must succeed for continuity; matching rejection or missing/timed-out observations are inconclusive.
The separate change/no-change runs were not simultaneous randomized trials; no exact causal latency, permanent validity, one-hour expiry, SDK, Rules or whole-lineage guarantee is made.
Raw token/identity secrets remain private; timing claims are decoded without signature verification. Normal cleanup is not fault-injected recovery.

preconditions.condition: Require exact client schemaVersion 1, enforcementState ENFORCE, minPasswordLength 6 and maxPasswordLength 4096; admin config must omit passwordPolicyConfig. This explicit readback is not inferred OFF. A 47-character generated password has uppercase/lowercase/numeric/non-alphanumeric characters; no configuration is changed.

interpretation.condition: Short REST continuity is distinct from SDK signature/revocation checks and real elapsed token expiry. No password-change or explicit revocation is performed during this observation.
